text:
Source-assisted reading of Stams, Frg. 187 (F-bjvu), made with PL 191 cols. 947-966 available. A research reader reread on the native images: canvas 0 left leaf col a (boxes 1280,820,2480,2300 and 1280,2250,2480,3650), canvas 1 left leaf col a (box 1280,1450,2480,2900), the first five lines of canvas 1 right leaf col a (box 3950,700,5150,1250) and the last lines of canvas 1 left leaf col b (box 2400,3350,3600,3950). Other columns rest on the image-only first reading. Expansions in parentheses; ? = uncertain; [..] = lost or unread; [x] = supplied.
